name: CSS Dark Theme
format:
<style>
body { background-color: #0f1117 !important; color: #e6e8ee !important; font-family: 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif !important; }
.nr-dashboard-theme { background-color: #0f1117 !important; }
md-card { background-color: #1a1d27 !important; border: 1px solid #2a2e3d !important; border-radius: 8px !important; }
.kpi-box { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 12px; background: #131620; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #2a2e3d; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.badge-active { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #6ee7b7; border: 1px solid #10b981; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; }
.badge-inactive { background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2); color: #fca5a5; border: 1px solid #ef4444; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; }
.badge-finger-yes { background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2); color: #6ee7b7; border: 1px solid #10b981; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; }
.badge-finger-no { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.2); color: #fde68a; border: 1px solid #f59e0b; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: bold; }
table.history-tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.85rem; }
table.history-tbl th { background: #131620; color: #22d3ee; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid #2a2e3d; text-align: left; }
table.history-tbl td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1e2230; }
table.history-tbl tr:hover td { background: rgba(34, 211, 238, 0.05); }
</style>
